notes: Each repeat runs fk_filter then radon_demultiple on the same seeded float32 gather; wall time includes harness conversions, and Metal includes two process launches and file I/O. F-k cutoff 487.3 m/s, Radon slowness 8e-7 s/m^2, offsets linearly span -300 to 300 m. Differences are the largest normalized maximum absolute error across the two outputs. Memory is the maximum over three repeats, not a median. Child ru_maxrss is a cumulative high-water mark, not additive or resettable: after warmup its delta may be zero and understate child memory. MLX process RSS is also a cumulative high-water mark. Runtime and memory estimates are unverified on the target machine.
